package service

import (
	"fmt"

	"gorm.io/driver/postgres"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for service_constructor_instantiates_dependencies_internally: Constructors that create repositories, clients, or loggers internally instead of accepting them explicitly.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type OrderService struct {
	db  *gorm.DB
	cfg Config
}

func NewOrderService(cfg Config) (*OrderService, error) {
	dsn := fmt.Sprintf("host=%s user=%s password=%s dbname=%s port=%s",
		cfg.DBHost, cfg.DBUser, cfg.DBPass, cfg.DBName, cfg.DBPort)
	db, err := gorm.Open(postgres.Open(dsn), &gorm.Config{})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open database: %w", err)
	}
	return &OrderService{db: db, cfg: cfg}, nil
}

type Config struct {
	DBHost string
	DBUser string
	DBPass string
	DBName string
	DBPort string
}
